messages.subject: Re: facets and functions
parts:
There might be a more elegant solution, but try this:

foo <- function(d=iris, x="Sepal.Length", y="Petal.Width", f="Species"){
  
  ggplot(d, aes_string(x=x, y=y)) +
    facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", f))) +
    geom_point()
}

foo()

HTH,

b.

messages.author: 9c9b5f9c6aaa025d
messages.subject: Re: facets and functions
parts:
Just to expand on Baptiste, you need to remember that if you pass variables you need to use aes_string, not aes (so your function never had a chance to work anyway independent of faceting). As for the faceting, you can still use facet_grid instead of facet_wrap, but again, remember you are passing a variable so you have to construct the formula using paste.

fun3 <- function(df, x.name, y.name, diff) {
ggplot(df, aes_string(x=x.name, y=y.name)) + geom_point() + facet_grid(paste0(".~",diff))

}

  ggplot(d, aes_string(x=x, y=y)) +
    facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", f))) +
    geom_point()
}

foo()

HTH,

b.

On 12 July 2013 10:14, Joseph Kreke <joseph...@gmail.com> wrote:
Another example (not looking for specific help, but general help with faceting):

Here is the command I'd like to execute (same dataset, it works at the console, got this command from playing at yeroon)
ggplot(fd.df, aes(x=RT, y=..count.., group=difficulty)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=0.1) + facet_wrap(~condition)


Here is my function
EDA <- function(df="fd.df", x.name="condition", y.name="RT", p.name="participant", difficulty="difficulty"){

  par(ask=F)
  p<-ggplot(df, aes(x=y.name, y=..count.., group=difficulty)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=0.1) + facet_wrap(~x.name)

  par(ask=T)
  
}


Executing this command, I get the following error.

JKreke

On Thu, Jul 11, 2013 at 7:04 PM, Doug Mitarotonda <dougmit...@gmail.com> wrote:
Just to expand on Baptiste, you need to remember that if you pass variables you need to use aes_string, not aes (so your function never had a chance to work anyway independent of faceting). As for the faceting, you can still use facet_grid instead of facet_wrap, but again, remember you are passing a variable so you have to construct the formula using paste.

fun3 <- function(df, x.name, y.name, diff) {
ggplot(df, aes_string(x=x.name, y=y.name)) + geom_point() + facet_grid(paste0(".~",diff))
}


On Jul 11, 2013, at 4:00 PM, baptiste auguie <baptist...@gmail.com> wrote:

There might be a more elegant solution, but try this:

foo <- function(d=iris, x="Sepal.Length", y="Petal.Width", f="Species"){
  
  ggplot(d, aes_string(x=x, y=y)) +
    facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", f))) +
    geom_point()
}

foo()

HTH,

b.
